# telnyx_external_connection_upload_start (Action)

Uploads phone numbers to an external connection, such as Microsoft Teams.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `number_ids` (List of String)

### Optional

- `additional_usages` (List of String)
- `civic_address_id` (String) Identifies the civic address to assign all phone numbers to.
- `location_id` (String) Identifies the location to assign all phone numbers to.
- `usage` (String) The use case of the upload request. NOTE: `calling_user_assignment` is not supported for toll free numbers. One of `calling_user_assignment`, `first_party_app_assignment`.
